typography.installation: Import 'Oswald' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.css

usage_rules: Use #FF6600 (Orange) for Primary Actions (Buttons, Active States).
Use #18181B (Black) for Secondary Buttons, Headings, and Strong Accents.
Background should be off-white (#F4F4F5) to reduce eye strain compared to pure white.
Cards must be pure white (#FFFFFF) with a subtle shadow to pop against the background.
NEVER use gradients on text. Keep text high-contrast.
Success states should use Emerald (#10B981), Error states Red (#EF4444).

layout.spacing_system: Comfortable but dense for data. Use p-4 for mobile, p-6 or p-8 for desktop containers.
layout.border_radius: rounded-sm (4px) - Tactical, sporty feel. Avoid large rounded corners.
layout.mobile_first: True. Design for 375px width first. Use Bottom Navigation for mobile view.

structure.dashboard: Grid Layout: Hero Widget (Full width mobile, 2/3 desktop), Quick Stats (1/3), List Feeds (Vertical).
structure.sidebar: Collapsible sidebar on desktop, Bottom Tab Bar on mobile.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-orange-600 rounded-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide shadow-sm transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 rounded-sm font-bold uppercase

cards.default: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-sm shadow-sm p-5 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

inputs.default: bg-white border-zinc-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-sm h-10 px-3
inputs.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500 mb-1.5 block

rules: Stagger children animations for lists (0.05s delay).

icons.usage: Use Duotone for decorative/large icons, Regular for UI controls. Color: Primary or Foreground.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle dot pattern on Dashboard Hero background (opacity 0.05).
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-lg for floating elements (modals, bottom nav).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders are preferred over shadows for separation in data tables.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the provided color palette and border radius.
Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Sidebar (Desktop) / BottomNav (Mobile) logic.
Use 'rounded-sm' consistently. Do NOT mix rounded-xl and rounded-sm.
Ensure the Primary Orange (#FF6600) is used for high-priority actions only.
Charts should use the Primary Orange for the main data series and Zinc-800 for secondary.
Use the provided image URLs for the Dashboard Hero and Login Page background.
Implement a 'PWA-ready' feel: sticky headers, bottom navigation, touch-friendly tap targets.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Use glass-morphism effects for the Bottom Navigation bar (backdrop-blur-lg).
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
